name: Nail Salon: Style and Makeup Bag
description:
Create your manicure nails in the Nintendo Switch™ System with Nail Salon: Style and Makeup Bag. 
- Choose beautiful nail polish colors, gradients, glitters, textures, patterns and amazing shapes.
- You'll be able to add amazing stickers and gems to your designs.
- Get a perfect manicure and give your hands the treatment they deserve to shine.
